`Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #35423 (#34990). Parent: #34990.

## What is now false
`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, Drilldown, the bullet **Escape hatch — "Open in list →"** (about lines 378–381) says the drawer header always offers a link to the object's full list page, scoped by the same drill filter. After #35423, a dataset dimension whose field is a relationship path (`account.owner`, up to three hops) drills as one nested-relation condition, and the list page's `filter[...]` URL dialect has no spelling for a nested condition, so the drawer offers no "Open in list" link for that drill. The drawer itself still lists the records.

The same promise is published in `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` (about line 306, "The drawer also offers an **"Open in list →"** escape hatch", and the note about line 338); correct both places (added from the narrowing contract review on PR #35423).

## Done when
The skill bullet and the docs page each state the exception (relationship-path dimensions: the drawer only, no list-page link) in one sentence, and the skill's evals still pass.

## Grade
p3 · area:data · domain:skills. A skill reader may promise a link that is not shown; no data is wrong.
